name: say-what-it-is
problem: Definitions for every element, parsed from the comments spec files already carry, constrained to identity prose. The comments exist and are invisible: the lexer drops them at tokenization, so what a node IS lives outside the model — unreadable to agents, unarchived by versions. Prose-pressure hardened the gate before code: obligations reject by vocabulary (the modal words, anywhere), not by punctuation; the statement API is a second door that needs the same shared validator; and the render round-trip must hold byte-stable with definitions inside, or every seal after the first lies.

technology_stack.tech: Rust 2024; crates/modeling-lang: source/lexer.rs (comment capture beside the token stream), source/defs.rs (new: the attach pass, pairing comments to elements by position), definition.rs (new: the shared prose validator), source/{ast,parser,resolve,lower}.rs + statement.rs (definition threading, source to batch), engine.rs + model.rs (storage, divergence rule, the second door), render.rs (canonical emission)
technology_stack.provenance: every change extends the pipeline stage it names in the model — the attach pass is a new stage between parse and bind, exactly where lang.arch places Compiler.Definitions; the engine and renderer changes ride seams the fold and remint rounds already proved

technology_stack.tech: trailing-comment canonical form: a definition renders as `// <text>` on its defining line, normalized at attach (block lines joined, whitespace collapsed) so the stored form is the emitted form
technology_stack.provenance: prose-pressure's the-render-echoes-what-it-stored: byte-stable seals demand one normal form, and the existing corpus already writes this exact style

architecture_summary.role: the prose gate: pairs comments with elements by position, normalizes, validates identity prose, rejects obligations — every violation one located diagnostic at the offending comment
stores definitions as element identity: no-op on identical restatement, reject on divergence with the stored actual, and the same shared validator guards the statement-API door
emits each definition as the trailing comment of its defining line, so dumps, archived renders and seals carry definitions byte-stably

stack_mapping.tech: source/lexer.rs + source/defs.rs + definition.rs + source pipeline threading
engine.rs + model.rs storage and both-door validation

scenarios: this repository's own model compiles with every existing trailing comment attached: archi build passes, the dump carries Agent.drive's `runs the verbs`, and check stays green

an obligation cannot enter: `must reject tabs in indentation` rejects at the comment — bare, comma-spliced or semicolon-spliced alike — and the same prose rejects through the statement API, both diagnostics naming the rule
the archive carries definitions: version save mints, the archived render reconstructs byte-identically against its seal, and every pre-definition version still reconstructs and compiles unchanged
a restatement with a divergent definition rejects carrying the stored actual, exactly as divergent ports do; an identical restatement no-ops

tasks.description: the prose gate and its plumbing: lexer captures comments beside the tokens, the attach pass pairs them to elements by position (trailing line or abutting block, blank line detaches, both-forms rejects), the shared validator enforces identity prose — one sentence, 240 chars, modal vocabulary rejects anywhere — and definitions thread ast → resolution → lowered define statements; engine/model/render get compile-threading only, their real work lands in t2/t3
tasks.stack_details: new source/defs.rs (attach) + definition.rs (validator); lexer.rs returns comments with lines; ast.rs carries doc fields; parser.rs threads; resolve.rs carries docs on NodeInfo/RelDefR/ConnDefR/ViewDefR; lower.rs + statement.rs put them on Definition; engine.rs/model.rs/render.rs touched only to keep patterns exhaustive

definitions-are-identity-prose: unit: an identity sentence passes and a 241-character one rejects naming the limit; a second sentence rejects while dotted tokens (mod.rs, plan.json) never split; every violation carries file:line:col of the offending comment, and all of a file's violations surface in one pass
definitions-parse-from-comments: unit: trailing and standalone comments are captured with their lines and the token stream is unchanged; definitions land on nodes, ports, views, rels and conns from both positions; a blank line detaches; open lines and whitespace-only comments attach nothing; trailing plus adjacent block is one located error
e2e: this repository's own sources compile with every existing trailing comment attached as its element's definition
obligations-never-define: unit: each of must, should, shall, ensures, handles rejects bare and under comma, semicolon, em-dash and colon splices alike; matching is whole-word and case-insensitive — mustard and handler pass; the validator is the single exported rule the engine consults in t2

tasks.description: definitions become element identity in the store: define statements carry them, the engine persists them on nodes, declared ports, views, rels and conns, no-ops identical restatements, rejects divergent ones with the stored actual, and consults the shared validator on every define — the statement-API door meets the source-path gate
tasks.stack_details: engine.rs define_{node,view,rel,conn} store docs + divergence compare (absent = no claim, mirroring ports); port docs only on declared ports, unknown port names reject; parse_statement strict schema admits the new fields; model.rs structs gain doc storage

inputs.t1: definition-carrying define statements in the lowered batch, and the shared validator exported for the engine to consult

agents-read-lowered-statements: the lowered define statements carry definitions, so dumps and the read envelope expose them to agents; the envelope stays read-only and its suite stays green
definitions-are-semantic: unit: an identical restatement no-ops; a divergent definition rejects carrying the stored actual, exactly as divergent ports do; an omitted definition makes no claim; port docs land only on declared ports
findings-never-block: definition violations are errors at the define gate, never findings; advisory finding surfaces and exit codes are untouched — suite stays green
obligations-never-define: unit: obligation prose rejects through parse_statement and through direct Workspace::execute alike, with the same rule text the source gate emits
one-semantic-authority: the engine re-checks definition prose on every define like any other constraint — the attach pass validates early but the engine remains the authority; no rule is duplicated, both doors call the one exported validator
unchanged-saves-close-rounds: the save/close ceremony is untouched by this task; the version e2e suite stays green

tasks.description: stored definitions reach every render: node/view/rel/conn statements rebuilt from the model carry their definitions, the canonical render emits them as trailing comments, render → compile → render is byte-identical, and the archive seals hold with definitions inside while pre-definition versions reconstruct unchanged
tasks.stack_details: render.rs node_statement/view_statement/rel_statement/conn_statement read docs off the model; scope_sources inherits them; e2e in crates/archi proves save → mint → reconstruct → seal with definitions and the backward path over v0001–v0008

inputs.t1: statement pseudo renders definitions as trailing comments on defining lines
inputs.t2: the model stores each element's definition where the render can read it

definitions-are-semantic: unit: a model with definitions renders canonically, recompiles to the identical model and re-renders byte-for-byte
e2e: a save after definitions land mints, and the archived version reconstructs against its seal
merge-deltas-are-reviewable: version diff renders definition changes as statement-level lines like any other define delta; the diff suite stays green
parallel-editing-discipline: no session, journal or fold path is touched; the multiplayer suites stay green
provenance-anchors-post-hoc: the anchor path is untouched; its suite stays green
remint-rejoins-the-lineage: the remint path is untouched; its suite stays green
renders-are-layout-blind: unit: the same definitions authored in different modules and orders render identically — definitions come from the stored model, never from layout
stress-pins-versions: e2e: every archived version v0001–v0008 (no definition comments) reconstructs and compiles under the new parser, so pinned affects expansion is unchanged
the-archive-is-sealed: e2e: reconstruction verifies seals with definitions inside; a tampered render still fails its seal
versions-mint-on-meaning: e2e: adding a definition changes the render, so save mints; a no-op save on the unchanged model still exits 0
